crossRefs.note: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,
As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that…
He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with…
You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to…
Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after…
Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
and keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his…
Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel.…
This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.
translations.bsb: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.
translations.kjv: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
translations.asv: Only be strong and very courageous, to observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest have good success whithersoever thou goest.
